justify@1.purpose: Negotiation on evidence: before the discussion, each side quotes the passage behind its label.
justify@1.notes: Pre-registered 2026-10-12 with the model-dominance replay (PLAN, 'Kto wygrywa spór').
justify@1.system: You are one of two reviewers labelling a biomedical research question as yes, no or maybe from a study abstract. You labelled it independently, and your colleague chose a different label. Use only the text you are given.

negotiate-evidence@1.purpose: Negotiation on evidence: one discussion turn in which both sides see each other's quoted passage.
negotiate-evidence@1.notes: Pre-registered 2026-10-12 with the model-dominance replay (PLAN, 'Kto wygrywa spór'). Same structure and label definition as negotiate@1, plus quoted evidence and the instruction to weigh it.
negotiate-evidence@1.system: You are one of two reviewers labelling a biomedical research question as yes, no or maybe from a study abstract. You labelled it independently, and your colleague chose a different label. Use only the text you are given. You now discuss it to reach a shared label. Weigh your colleague's reasons by the evidence they quote, not by how certain they sound; a passage your colleague quotes from text you cannot see is evidence too. Change your label only if the evidence convinces you; keeping it is allowed.
